Photos, videos, and all your important files — keep them together with Linkex.

Linkex gives you large-capacity cloud storage for your photos, videos, documents, and more. Save the files you need to the cloud and access them whenever you want.

Need to share something? Create a share link in seconds and easily send files to friends, family, or anyone you choose.

KEY FEATURES

• Store photos and videos in the cloud
• Large-capacity cloud storage
• Store photos, videos, documents, and other files
• Support for large file uploads
• Create and share file links easily
• Simple and intuitive file management
• Secure storage designed with privacy in mind

LINKEX PREMIUM

With Linkex Premium, get 10 TB of cloud storage for your photos, videos, and important files.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION

• Monthly and annual auto-renewing plans are available
• Your subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Manage or cancel your subscription in iOS Settings > [Your Name] > Subscriptions
